images.label: Homepage
images.description: The homepage: the headline centered with its red full stop, a label over it, a grey line under it, the lockup above, hairline guides and the address at the foot.
images.command: conare-ds image hero --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --body "Conare finds the right answer in any data you bring, for your agents and the products you build on them." --badge "Search across 100M+ documents" --note "SOC 2 Type I · GDPR"

images.label: Brief
images.description: The formal statement: the lockup top left, a red-marked line in mono capitals top right, the words set left, a hairline and the address.
images.command: conare-ds image brief --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --body "Conare finds the right answer in any data you bring, for your agents and the products you build on them." --badge "Announcement" --note "SOC 2 Type I · GDPR"

images.label: Tile
images.description: The wordmark as a tile in a bordered panel, a stack of documents on it, the words beside it.
images.command: conare-ds image tile --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --badge "Search across 100M+ documents"

images.label: Product
images.description: Words with the dark agent window (or your picture) on the perspective room, stacks of documents at the sides.
images.command: conare-ds image app --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --badge "Search across 100M+ documents"

images.label: Outline
images.description: The wordmark, huge and hollow, along the foot; the words above it.
images.command: conare-ds image outline --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --badge "Search across 100M+ documents"

images.label: Hatched
images.description: Fine hatching across the floor, a wide stack standing on it, the words set right.
images.command: conare-ds image hatch --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --badge "Search across 100M+ documents"

images.label: Red room
images.description: The share image: red, the perspective room, stacks of documents at the sides, the mark over the words.
images.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --body "Conare finds the right answer in any data you bring, for your agents and the products you build on them." --badge "Search across 100M+ documents"

images.label: Feature
images.description: A launch: a label, the words, and a product scene under them (your picture with --image).
images.command: conare-ds image feature --headline "Reranking on every query." --body "conare-rerank-1 orders retrieved passages by relevance before they reach your agent, within the same API and the same security controls." --badge "Product update"

images.label: Lockup
images.description: A partnership: the lockup and the partner's name, the words under them, on a faint wordmark tile in a hairline frame.
images.command: conare-ds image partner --headline "Conare now connects to Acme." --body "Acme data is indexed, kept in sync and searchable through the same API key." --badge "Integration" --partner "Acme"

images.label: Big number
images.description: A big number or milestone on the room, the mark alone at the top, stacks at the sides.
images.command: conare-ds image funding --headline "Search across 100M+ documents." --body "Each one synced, parsed, embedded and returned with its source." --badge "Milestone"

images.label: Announcement
images.description: A solid red border, the words set large at the top left, the lockup at the foot.
images.command: conare-ds image announce --headline "Build retrieval for the enterprise." --badge "Careers"

images.label: Card
images.description: The new-feature card: the lockup top left, a black chip top right, the words between them, a mono line along the foot.
images.command: conare-ds image card --headline "Reranking on every query." --body "conare-rerank-1 orders retrieved passages by relevance before they reach your agent, within the same API and the same security controls." --badge "NEW" --note "SOC 2 Type I · GDPR"

images.label: Profile picture
images.description: The mark alone, centered on the theme, inside the circle a profile picture is cropped to.

sizes.label: Link preview
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size og

sizes.label: Square post
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size square

sizes.label: Portrait post
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size portrait

sizes.label: Story
sizes.note: Meta asks for about 14% at the top (250 px) and 20% at the bottom (340 px) to stay free. Its page draws the numbers with a script and could not be read, so they are approximate. Reels covers are stricter (about 35% at the bottom).
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size story

sizes.label: Landscape post
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size landscape

sizes.label: X header
sizes.note: X recommends 1500 x 500 and the header is cropped by up to about 60 px at the top and bottom. The profile picture covers the lower left: its place is measured on x.com at its 600 px column, so it is approximate.
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size x-banner

sizes.label: LinkedIn post
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size linkedin

sizes.label: LinkedIn profile cover
sizes.note: 1584 x 396 and under 8 MB are LinkedIn's. Where the profile picture sits is measured on the desktop page, so it is approximate.
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size linkedin-banner

sizes.label: LinkedIn page cover
sizes.note: 1512 x 256, 3 MB, and "keep key details away from the edges, especially the lower-right corner" are LinkedIn's. The widths of those edges are approximate, as it gives none. (The older 1128 x 191 is the same shape to within 1%.)
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size linkedin-page

sizes.label: YouTube channel art
sizes.note: YouTube: 2560 x 1440 recommended, words and logos inside 1235 x 338 of 2048 x 1152, 6 MB or smaller.
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size youtube

sizes.label: YouTube thumbnail
sizes.note: YouTube takes 2 MB from a phone and 50 MB from a computer; the check warns at 2 MB. Where the video length sits is approximate.
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size youtube-thumbnail

sizes.label: Email header
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size email

sizes.label: Profile picture
sizes.note: X takes 2 MB; YouTube takes 15 MB. Shown as a circle, so everything stays inside the square the circle holds.
sizes.command: conare-ds image avatar --size avatar

sizes.label: LinkedIn square
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size linkedin-square

sizes.label: Facebook cover
sizes.note: Facebook shows the cover at 820 by 312 on a computer and crops its sides to about 640 by 360 on a phone; the profile picture covers the lower left on a computer. Facebook publishes the display sizes; the covered corner is measured, so approximate.
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size facebook-cover

sizes.label: Pinterest pin
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size pinterest

sizes.label: Display ad, medium rectangle
sizes.note: IAB medium rectangle. Ad networks take about 150 KB; write jpg or webp, and --scale 2 for sharp screens.
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size ad-300x250

sizes.label: Display ad, large rectangle
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size ad-336x280

sizes.label: Display ad, leaderboard
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size ad-728x90

sizes.label: Display ad, half page
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size ad-300x600

sizes.label: Display ad, mobile banner
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size ad-320x50

sizes.label: Display ad, wide skyscraper
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size ad-160x600

sizes.label: Display ad, billboard
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size ad-970x250

sizes.label: Video call background
sizes.note: Zoom and Meet take 16:9 at 1920 by 1080. The person sits in the middle; words and the logo keep to the sides and top. The middle's size is a convention, so approximate. The picture is mirrored to the person but not to others.
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size zoom-background

sizes.label: Desktop wallpaper
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size wallpaper-desktop

sizes.label: Phone wallpaper
sizes.note: The clock covers the top and the dock or swipe bar the bottom on a phone lock screen; the middle is kept for words, measured on a 6.1 in phone, so approximate.
sizes.command: conare-ds image room --headline "Everything your agent needs to know." --size wallpaper-phone

slides.label: Cover
slides.description: The homepage layout: the lockup, the title centered with its red stop, a red label, a line under it and the address.

slides.label: Section
slides.description: A divider on the red room: the mark, the section number in a label and the title, stacks at the sides.

slides.label: Agenda
slides.description: The title and up to eight numbered points in the display face, a hairline between them.
slides.command: conare-ds deck agenda --title "Today." --items "Where Acme searches today | What changes | The rollout | Questions"

slides.label: Statement
slides.description: One sentence set left, the lockup top left, an optional red-marked line top right, the footer.

slides.label: Bullets
slides.description: A title and up to six points, each marked with the brand's small red square.

slides.label: Stat
slides.description: A big number on the red room with a line under it, the mark at the top, stacks at the sides.

slides.label: Chart
slides.description: Bars from data ("label number | ..."): the brand has no chart style, so bars are its hairline grey with the largest in the accent, labels and values in mono.
slides.command: conare-ds deck chart --title "Searches a week at Acme." --data "Mon 120 | Tue 180 | Wed 240 | Thu 210 | Fri 160"

slides.label: Timeline
slides.description: Two to six points along a hairline, each marked with the red square: "when: what".
slides.command: conare-ds deck timeline --title "The rollout." --items "May: Connect the help center | June: Sync the shared drive | July: Open search to every team"

slides.label: Comparison
slides.description: Two columns under a title, each a heading and up to six points, split by a hairline; the right column is marked in red.
slides.command: conare-ds deck comparison --title "Before and after." --left "Before" --right "After" --leftItems "Folders searched by hand | Answers without sources" --rightItems "One search across every file | Every answer with its source"

slides.label: Quote
slides.description: A quote set large over the hollow wordmark, the attribution in a red-marked line above it.

slides.label: Image
slides.description: A title, a label and a line, and your picture in the product window (a wordless stand-in scene without one).

slides.label: Image grid
slides.description: One to four of your pictures, each shown whole in a hairline frame ("images": [...] in the deck file).
slides.command: conare-ds deck grid --title "What the team made."

slides.label: Team
slides.description: Up to eight people as name and role in hairline cards ("Name, role | ..."); no photos.
slides.command: conare-ds deck team --title "The Acme team." --people "Acme admin, Head of search | Acme engineer, Platform | Acme designer, Product | Acme lead, Support"

slides.label: Questions
slides.description: A closing slide for questions on the red room: your title and a line (an address or a name to write to).

slides.label: End
slides.description: The end card: the full lockup on the red room, a line and the address.

illustrations.description: A stack of documents, tall or wide (--shape tall|wide). --image puts your picture on the front sheet.
The share image's scene: the perspective room with stacks of documents squared up at the sides.
The red pixel grid alone (--seed reshuffles it).
The perspective room: a back wall, rings stepping out faster toward the edges, lines from the wall out past the frame.
The wordmark as a staggered tile, at the theme's faint strength.
The wordmark huge and hollow along the foot.
Fine 45 degree hatching across a floor, a wide stack on it.
Documents searched: a strip of small squares with a few found in red (--seed moves them).
The dark agent window with its sample copy.
The product scene: the red room, stacks at the sides and the agent window in front (the feature layout's stand-in).
